- Kept the actual response artifact to one usable caption. No claim ledger or explanation is needed in the caption.

## Editorial check and limitations

Manual editorial review checked plain personal language, prospective tense, consistency with the supplied never-visited fact, a maximum of two sentences, and the absence of unsupported destination information or a CTA. No outside travel facts were used or verified. The result is a draft caption only; no publication or actual trip is claimed.
